title: Empress
summary: EM'PRESS, noun [Contracted from emperess. See Emperor.] The consort or spouse of an emperor. 1. A female who governs an empire; a female invested with imperial power or sovereignty.

inlines.v: EM'PRESS, noun [Contracted from emperess. See Emperor.] The consort or spouse of an emperor. 1. A female who governs an empire; a female invested with imperial power or sovereignty.
